question: How many requests does typing “quarterly invoice” (17 characters, at normal speed) send to /search, before and after PR 214?

measured.name: Requests to /search for one typed query
measured.note: Dev server, network panel, one run each

explanation: Before: one request per keystroke. After: a 250 ms timer restarts on every keystroke, so only the pauses after “quart”, after “quarterly ” and at the end of the text sent a request.
